about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification with European and Japanese controls and hydraulics — Delem, Estun, Hawe, Rexroth, Schneider, Siemens, NOK — inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, as every machine we sell.

The swing beam shears cut the full length in one stroke with a beam on two cylinders, an Estun E21S control positioning the motorised back gauge and setting the cutting angle, and hydraulic hold-downs every 100 mm — 32 models from 5/32″ × 8 ft to 3/4″ × 13 ft. The guillotine shears carry the blade beam on linear rollers with a rake angle the control sets between 0.5° and 4°, so thin sheet is cut fast and flat and 1″ plate with less twist — 34 models from 1/4″ to 1-9/16″ over 8 to 26 ft. Ball-transfer front tables, shadow-line light, squaring arm and light-barrier guards are standard on both.
